title: tylophora asthmatica
intro: Tylophora asthmatica, commonly known as Vatsanabha, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including asthma, bronchitis, and skin disorders, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tylophora asthmatica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which help in relieving respiratory issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
